units.text: 9) the difference between the amount of the administrative fine that would have been imposed for the administrative offence had accurate details (information) necessary to calculate the administrative fine been provided and the amount of the administrative fine imposed;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 10) the cadastral value of a land plot;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 11) the value of unperformed obligations provided for by a contract for the supply of goods, performance of works or provision of services;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 12) the price of a transaction concluded by a state (municipal) unitary enterprise or a state (municipal) institution;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 13) the amount of funds received by the editorial office of a mass media outlet, a broadcaster or a publisher, information about the receipt of which must be provided in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on the mass media;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 14) the amount of a previously imposed administrative fine;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 15) the amount of the environmental levy;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 16) the amount of a payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 17) the amount of a credit institution's own funds (capital);
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 18) the amount of funds subject to blocking or unblocking in the bank account of a participant in procurement or a participant in mandatory tendering procedures;
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 19) the amount of funds deposited as security for an application or as security for performance of a contract;
units.label: Point 19 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 20) the price of a state (municipal) contract, an agreement (arrangement), or a contract (agreement);
units.label: Point 20 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 21) the product of the amount of the administrative fine and the number of units of goods sold whose shelf life has expired.
units.label: Point 21 Part 1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 2. The amount of an administrative fine may not be less than one hundred roubles, or, for an administrative offence in the field of road traffic, less than five hundred roubles, except in the case provided for by part 1.3 of Article 32.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.5

units.text: 3. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the value of the object of the administrative offence, or on the basis of the amount of unpaid taxes, levies or customs duties, or the amount of an unlawful foreign exchange transaction, or the amount of funds transferred without opening a bank account using electronic means of payment provided by foreign payment service providers, or the amount of funds credited during the reporting period to an electronic means of payment provided by a foreign payment service provider, or the amount of funds not credited within the prescribed period to accounts with authorised banks, or the amount of funds calculated as a multiple of the key rate of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation applied to the amount of funds credited to accounts with authorised banks after the prescribed deadline, or the amount of funds not returned to the Russian Federation within the prescribed period, or the amount of funds due to a resident from a non-resident, or the amount of funds, the value of securities or other property, or the value of services of a proprietary nature unlawfully transferred or provided on behalf of a legal entity, or the amount of funds received from a budget of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation and used for purposes other than those designated, or the amount of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of the fee for the use of a budget loan not transferred within the prescribed period to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of a budget loan received, or the amount of a budget investment received, or the amount of a subsidy received, or the amount of funds to be credited to accounts of budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation, or the amount of funds involved in unlawfully conducted transactions, or the undeclared amount of cash and (or) the value of monetary instruments, or the amount of a settlement made without the use of cash register equipment, or the amount of the environmental levy, may not exceed three times the value of the object of the administrative offence or the corresponding amount or value; in the cases provided for by Articles 7.27 and 7.27.1 of this Code, it may not exceed five times the value of the stolen property; in the cases provided for by parts 1 - 2 of Article 14.4.3, part 2 of Article 14.10, parts 1 and 2 of Article 15.44 and part 1 of Article 15.45 of this Code, it may not exceed five times the value of the object of the administrative offence; in the case provided for by Article 14.15.2 of this Code, it may not exceed, for citizens, twenty-five times the value of the admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, or the value of an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match specified in the document entitling its holder to obtain an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, and, for officials, thirty times the value of the admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence, or the value of an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match specified in the document entitling its holder to obtain an admission ticket to a UEFA 2020 European Football Championship match that was the object of the administrative offence; in the cases provided for by Articles 7.1 and 8.8 of this Code, it may not exceed one hundred thousand roubles for citizens, three hundred thousand roubles for officials and seven hundred thousand roubles for legal entities; and, in the case provided for by Article 19.28 of this Code, one hundred times the amount of funds or the value of securities, other property, services of a proprietary nature or other property rights unlawfully transferred or provided, or promised or offered, on behalf of a legal entity.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, or on the basis of the offender's expenditure on acquiring the goods (works, services) in the market for which the administrative offence was committed, may not exceed one twenty-fifth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.1. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds obtained from the sale of goods (works, services) as a result of unlawfully inflating state-regulated prices (tariffs, charges, rates and the like) may not exceed twice the excess proceeds obtained over the entire period of regulation during which the offence was committed, but for no more than one year.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.2. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the difference between the amount of the administrative fine that would have been imposed for the administrative offence had accurate details (information) necessary to calculate the administrative fine been provided and the amount of the administrative fine imposed may not exceed ten times the amount of the administrative fine imposed.
units.label: Part 4.2 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.3. The amount of an administrative fine calculated as a multiple of the amount of a previously imposed administrative fine may not exceed twice the amount of the administrative fine imposed.
units.label: Part 4.3 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.4. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) may not exceed one fifth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of all goods (works, services) for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year preceding the date of detection of the administrative offence, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale or acquisition of goods (works, services) in the preceding calendar year.
units.label: Part 4.4 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.5. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of fuel may not exceed 3 percent of the proceeds from the sale of fuel for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not carry on activities involving the sale of fuel in the preceding calendar year.
units.label: Part 4.5 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.6. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the amount of a payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited may not exceed 40 percent of the amount of the payment accepted for the benefit of a person for whose benefit payments may not be accepted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited.
units.label: Part 4.6 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.7. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the offender's proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at a coal mine may not exceed one tenth of the aggregate proceeds from the sale of coal (oil shale) extracted at that coal mine for the calendar year preceding the year in which the administrative offence was detected, or for the part of the calendar year in which the administrative offence was detected that preceded the date of detection, if the offender did not extract coal (oil shale) at that coal mine in the preceding calendar year.
units.label: Part 4.7 Art. 3.5

units.text: 4.8. The amount of an administrative fine calculated on the basis of the amount of a credit institution's own funds (capital) may not exceed 3 percent of the amount of that credit institution's own funds (capital).
units.label: Part 4.8 Art. 3.5

units.text: 5. The amount of an administrative fine shall be credited to the budget in full in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 3.5

units.text: 6. An administrative fine may not be applied to sergeants, petty officers, soldiers and sailors performing military service by conscription, or to cadets of military vocational educational organisations and military higher educational organisations before a contract for military service has been concluded with them.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 3.5

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.label: Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 1. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence means the compulsory transfer, without compensation, of things not withdrawn from circulation into federal ownership or into the ownership of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Confiscation shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 2. Confiscation of hunting weapons, ammunition and other permitted hunting or fishing implements may not be applied to persons for whom hunting or fishing is the principal lawful source of their livelihood.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 3. The seizure from the unlawful possession of a person who has committed an administrative offence of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, the administrative offence does not constitute confiscation where those items:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: are subject to return to their lawful owner in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.7 · “are subject to return to their lawful owner in accordance with…”

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: have been withdrawn from circulation or were unlawfully possessed by the person who committed the administrative offence for other reasons, and on that ground are subject to transfer into state ownership or destruction.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.7 · “have been withdrawn from circulation or were unlawfully…”

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 4. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence owned by a person who has not been held administratively liable for that administrative offence and has not been found guilty of committing it by a court shall not be applied, except for administrative offences in the field of customs affairs (violations of customs rules) provided for by Chapter 16 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 4.1. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by part 1, 2, 2.1, 3, 4, 4.1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 10.1, 10.2, 11 or 12 of Article 13.15, part 4 of Article 19.34 or Article 20.29 of this Code and that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.7. Confiscation of the instrument used to commit, or the object of, an administrative offence
units.text: 5. If property obtained as a result of an administrative offence provided for by Article 15.27.3 of this Code has been combined with lawfully acquired property, the portion of the property corresponding to the value of the property so combined shall be subject to confiscation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 3.7

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.label: Art. 3.8

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.label: Art. 3.8

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: 1. Deprivation of a previously granted special right of an individual who has committed an administrative offence is established for a gross or systematic breach of the rules governing the exercise of that right in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code. Deprivation of a previously granted special right of an individual is also established for evasion of the enforcement of another administrative penalty imposed for a breach of the rules governing the exercise of that right, in the cases provided for by the articles of the Special Part of this Code, and for breach of a temporary restriction on the exercise of a special right imposed in accordance with legislation on enforcement proceedings. Deprivation of a special right shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.8

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: 2. The period of deprivation of a special right may not be less than one month or more than three years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.8

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: 3. Deprivation of the special right to operate a vehicle may not be applied to a person who uses a vehicle in connection with a disability, except where administrative offences provided for by parts 1 and 2 of Article 12.8, part 7 of Article 12.9, part 3 of Article 12.10, part 5 of Article 12.15, part 3.1 of Article 12.16, Article 12.24, part 1 of Article 12.26 and parts 2 and 3 of Article 12.27 of this Code have been committed.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.8

units.locator: Article 3.8. Deprivation of a special right
units.text: 4. Deprivation of the special right to hunt may not be applied to persons for whom hunting is the principal lawful source of their livelihood, except in the cases provided for by part 1.2 of Article 8.37 of this Code.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3.8

units.text: Article 3.9. Administrative arrest
units.label: Art. 3.9

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.9. Administrative arrest
units.label: Art. 3.9

units.text: 1. Administrative arrest consists in holding an offender in isolation from society and is established for a period of up to fifteen days, or up to thirty days for a violation of the established procedure for organising or holding an assembly, rally, demonstration, procession or picketing, or for organising the simultaneous mass presence or movement of citizens in public places resulting in a breach of public order, for a violation of the requirements of a state of emergency, martial law or the legal regime of a counter-terrorist operation, or for the commission of administrative offences under legislation on narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and their precursors. Administrative arrest shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.9

units.text: 2. Administrative arrest is established and imposed only in exceptional cases for particular types of administrative offences and may not be applied to pregnant women; women with children under the age of fourteen and (or) children with disabilities, or women who are adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; men who are single parents with children under the age of fourteen and (or) children with disabilities, or who are the sole adoptive parents, guardians or custodians of such children; persons under the age of eighteen; persons with disabilities of groups I and II; military personnel; citizens called up for military training; or employees holding special ranks in the Investigative Committee of the Russian Federation, internal affairs bodies, bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system, compulsory enforcement bodies of the Russian Federation, the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation, the State Fire Service and customs authorities. Administrative arrest shall not be applied where a person is held administratively liable for committing outside the Russian Federation an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.48, part 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1 or 20.29 of this Code, or an administrative offence consisting in failure to pay, within the time limit provided for by this Code, an administrative fine imposed for an administrative offence provided for by Article 13.14.1, 13.15, 13.36, 13.37, 13.48, 17.13 or 19.34, part 3, 4 or 5 of Article 20.1 or Article 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.3, 20.3.4, 20.29 or 20.33 of this Code, if that person is outside the Russian Federation when the case concerning the corresponding administrative offence is heard.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.9

units.text: 3. The period of administrative detention shall count towards the period of administrative arrest.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.9

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.label: Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Administrative expulsion of foreign citizens or stateless persons from the Russian Federation consists in the compulsory and supervised movement of those citizens and persons across the State Border of the Russian Federation to a place outside the Russian Federation (hereinafter referred to as compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation), or, in the cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, in the supervised independent departure of foreign citizens and stateless persons from the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 2. Administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation as an administrative penalty is established in respect of foreign citizens or stateless persons and shall be imposed by a judge or by a body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 3. Administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation may not be applied to military personnel who are foreign citizens or stateless persons.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 4. When imposing an administrative penalty in the form of administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation, the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code shall decide on that person's compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation or supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation, taking into account the length of that foreign citizen's or stateless person's residence in the Russian Federation, family situation, attitude to paying taxes provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation, availability of income and housing within the Russian Federation, occupation and profession, law-abiding conduct, application for admission to citizenship of the Russian Federation and other circumstances.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 5. For the purpose of enforcing an administrative penalty imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person in the form of compulsory expulsion from the Russian Federation, the judge, body or official specified in points 1, 2 and 10 - 12 of part 2 of Article 23.3 and part 2 of Article 23.10 of this Code may place such persons in a special institution provided for by Federal Law No. 115-FZ of 25 July 2002 'On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation'.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 3.10

units.locator: Article 3.10. Administrative expulsion of a foreign citizen or stateless person from the Russian Federation
units.text: 6. An administrative penalty in the form of supervised independent departure from the Russian Federation may be imposed on a foreign citizen or stateless person where administrative expulsion from the Russian Federation is carried out at the expense of that foreign citizen or stateless person, or at the expense of the inviting body, the diplomatic mission or consular institution of the foreign state of which the expelled foreign citizen is a citizen, an international organisation or its representative office, or an individual or legal entity specified in Article 16 of Federal Law No. 115-FZ of 25 July 2002 'On the Legal Status of Foreign Citizens in the Russian Federation'.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 3.10

units.text: Article 3.11. Disqualification
units.label: Art. 3.11

units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 3.11. Disqualification
units.label: Art. 3.11

units.text: 1. Disqualification consists in depriving an individual of the right to hold positions in the federal state civil service, positions in the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or positions in the municipal service; to hold positions in the executive management body of a legal entity; to serve on a board of directors (supervisory board); to carry on business activities involving the management of a legal entity; to manage a legal entity in other cases provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation; or to carry out activities involving the provision of state and municipal services (assistance in exercising certain powers in the provision of such services), activities in the field of training athletes (including their medical care) and organising and holding sporting events, activities in the field of industrial safety expert examinations, activities in the field of vehicle technical inspections, activities in the field of independent fire risk assessment (fire safety auditing), activities involving the design of fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been commissioned, expert examination activities in the field of the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs, medical or pharmaceutical activities, or activities in the field of managing apartment buildings. An administrative penalty in the form of disqualification shall be imposed by a judge.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 3.11

units.text: 2. Disqualification is established for a period of six months to three years.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 3.11

units.text: 3. Disqualification may be applied to persons holding positions in the federal state civil service, positions in the state civil service of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or positions in the municipal service; persons performing organisational and managerial or administrative and economic functions in a body of a legal entity; members of a board of directors (supervisory board); persons carrying on business without forming a legal entity; persons engaged in private practice; persons employed by multifunctional centres for the provision of state and municipal services (hereinafter referred to as a multifunctional centre), by other organisations performing the functions of a multifunctional centre in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, or by a public-law company providing state services in the field of state cadastral registration and state registration of rights; or employees of a federal state unitary enterprise authorised by and subordinate to the federal executive body responsible for internal affairs, or of an organisation authorised by the federal city of Moscow, which, in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation, assist in exercising certain powers in providing state services and performing functions in the field of migration (hereinafter referred to as a subordinate enterprise or authorised organisation); or coaches, sports medicine specialists or other specialists in the field of physical culture and sport holding positions included in a list approved in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation; or experts in the field of industrial safety; or experts in the field of fire risk assessment; or persons carrying out activities involving the design of fire safety systems for buildings and structures that have been commissioned; or persons carrying out expert examination activities in the field of the procurement of goods, works and services to meet state and municipal needs; medical workers; pharmaceutical workers; or persons carrying out activities in the field of managing apartment buildings; or technical experts in the field of vehicle technical inspections.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 3.11

units.text: Article 3.12. Administrative suspension of activities
units.label: Art. 3.12
